sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points, face a tough away trip to struggling Telford Town on Saturday 7 November at 15:00, looking to bounce back from consecutive league defeats. The Ramblers will then host New Mills in the Edward Case Cup on Saturday 14 November at 15:00, providing an opportunity to build momentum across both competitions.
divisionWide: Saturday's opening round sees several key title-race fixtures: second-placed Stafford Town (29 pts) travel to AFC Bridgnorth (27 pts) in a tight contest, while third-placed Eccleshall (28 pts) host New Mills at home. Fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals (28 pts), in excellent form with four consecutive wins, welcome Foley Meir to Brinsford. Fifth-ranked Bilston Town (26 pts) face Cheadle Heath Nomads, while Barnton (25 pts) travel to Market Drayton Town (14 pts). Allscott Heath host Wednesfield Community, Brereton Social face Shawbury United, and Crewe play Dawley Town. On Tuesday 10 November, Widnes Town visit AFC Bridgnorth. Wednesday's midweek action sees Bilston Town host Alsager Town and Wolverhampton Casuals entertain New Mills. Saturday 14 November features Allscott Heath's home clash with Dawley Town, Bilston Town hosting Eccleshall, Brereton Social against Crewe, Foley Meir visiting Market Drayton Town, Telford Town hosting Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Wednesfield Community travelling to Widnes Town.
